concerns.text: FR-008 and Constitution Principle VI require validation against an INDEPENDENT PUBLISHED therapy-response signature (PMID 32012345 gene set) via Fisher's exact test. The plan instead derives the signature from GSE138852 responder/non-responder labels ('therapy-response signature derived from GSE138852 response labels if available'). A dataset-internal label-derived signature is not the published independent signature the spec and constitution mandate, and the plan never mentions PMID 32012345 or how its gene set will be obtained/verified. The Constitution-Check row for Principle VI claims PASS, but the plan's substitution weakens the predictor/predicted independence the principle exists to protect. Amend Phase 7 to use the published signature (with verified citation per Principle II), keeping dataset labels as a secondary analysis if desired.
